run_gmock_output_test: run the gmock output test and compare normalized output against the golden file
normalize_test_output: normalize gmock test output by removing headers, locations, memory addresses, and leaky test names
extract_leaky_tests: extract a list of test names that leak mock objects from gmock output text
normalize_line_endings: convert Windows and Mac line endings in a string to UNIX line endings
generate_golden_file: run the gmock output test with the --gengolden flag to regenerate the golden file
